Stair lifts · Michigan

Stair Lifts for Michigan Homes, Installed in Days

The stairs shouldn't decide which rooms you get to use. A stair chair lift for your home gives you back the upstairs bedroom, the basement laundry, and the peace of mind that comes with not worrying about a fall.

Senior Home Solutions is your accessibility concierge. We assess the whole home, match you with the right lift, and our team handles a safe, professional installation from start to finish.

✓  Affordable straight stair lifts, starting at $X,XXX fully installed

✓  Installed in days, not weeks

✓  The rail attaches to your stair treads, not your walls

Get My Free Stair Lift Quote 📞 Call (586) 997-0750

★★★★★  5.0 on Google from 240+ Michigan families

Start here

What Do Your Stairs Look Like?

Stand at the bottom of your staircase and look up. Pick the description that matches.

Most common

My stairs go straight up

No turns, no landings, no curves. This is the most common staircase in Michigan homes, and the fastest and most affordable to fit.

See Straight Stair Lifts »

Money saver

My stairs have a flat landing in the middle

You may not need an expensive custom curved lift. Two straight lifts can do the same job for far less.

See the Two-Lift Solution »

Pricing

I just want to know the cost

Straight answers on what a stair lift costs in Michigan, what affects the price, and how people pay for one.

Read the Cost Guide »

Stairs that curve, spiral or have pie-shaped steps? Those need a custom curved lift, which costs more and takes weeks to build. Read how straight and curved lifts compare, or call us and we'll tell you honestly what will work.

A Stair Lift That Works for the Whole Family

If the lift is for you

You keep your home the way it is. The rail sits on the stair treads, the seat folds up out of the way, and the rest of the family can still use the stairs. You stay independent, on your own terms.

If you're arranging this for a parent

You get one point of contact, a clear price before any work starts, and an installation measured in days. We handle the assessment, the product and the install, so you're not managing three companies from two hours away.

Why SHS

Why Michigan Families Choose Senior Home Solutions

Installed in days

Straight lifts use standard rails that are cut to fit, so there's no waiting on a factory.

No damage to your walls

The rail fastens to the stair treads. If the lift is ever removed, the stairs are easy to restore.

A clear price up front

Starting at $X,XXX fully installed. You see the full price before you decide.

A whole-home view

A Certified Aging in Place Specialist looks beyond the staircase, at entrances, bathrooms and anything else that could cause a fall.

How it works

How Our Stair Lift Concierge Service Works

1

Tell us about your stairs

Call or send the form. A few questions and a couple of photos are usually enough to know if a straight lift will fit.

2

Free home assessment

We measure the staircase, check the fit for the person who will use it, and give you a firm price.

3

Professional installation

Our installers fit the lift, typically in two to four hours, and show you how to use it.

Ramp and Stair Lift Installed in One Week in Milford, MI

A Milford family needed both a wheelchair ramp and a stair lift before their father came home from a procedure. We measured on a Sunday and had the stair lift installed by the end of that week. The lift itself took about two hours to fit.

Read the Milford project »

Free, no obligation

Get a Free Stair Lift Quote

Tell us a little about the staircase and who the lift is for. We reply within 24 hours. There's no cost and no obligation.

✓ Free home assessment
✓ Firm, all-in price before any work
✓ Serving Metro Detroit and communities across Michigan

📞 Or call (586) 997-0750

Stair Lift Questions We Hear Most

How much does a stair lift cost?

Most straight stair lifts in Michigan run between $3,000 and $5,500 fully installed [CONFIRM]. Our cost guide explains what moves the price.

How long does installation take?

A straight stair lift is typically installed in two to four hours once the equipment is on site.

Will a stair lift damage my house?

No. The rail attaches to the stair treads, not the wall, so there's no cutting into drywall or structure.

What if my stairs have a landing?

Often two straight lifts solve it for less than one custom curved lift. See stairs with landings.
